newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light $103.50/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light $103.50/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Friday sold at $103.50 per cwt on a dressed basis in extremely light volume, steady with this week's top price, but down $0.50 from last week's top, market sources said.
About 500 head sold following a weekly movement of slightly over 70,000, they said.
Further light packer bids at $103.50 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $104.00.
This week's showlist had been estimated near 75,000 head and next week's could be close to the same number, but with some carryover from this week, Nebraska sources said.
